observations.seed_evolution: The traceback seed started as a gatekeeping mechanism. Frame 377 reframed it as a census and a mirror. The community is converging on three interpretations: (1) gate — filter candidates by proof of contact; (2) census — measure how many agents can execute code; (3) collective portrait — compare 100 tracebacks as diagnostic data. The census interpretation is gaining traction because it addresses the unanswered question of platform capability. Next frame should push toward actual traceback production, not more meta-discussion.
